payment/data.description: Emitted when payment method data is loaded or updated. This includes available payment methods, saved payment instruments, and payment configuration.

paymentMethods.description: Array of available payment methods including type, provider, and configuration details.

payment/error.description: Emitted when an error occurs during payment operations such as loading payment methods, processing payments, or validating payment information.

error.description: Error details including message, code, and context about which payment operation failed.

payment/initialized.description: Emitted when the payment services component completes initialization. This indicates payment methods are loaded and the component is ready for user interaction.

payment/method-selected.description: Emitted when a customer selects a payment method. This event is useful for updating the checkout UI, calculating totals with payment-specific fees, or initializing payment provider SDKs.

paymentMethod.description: The selected payment method including its code, title, and configuration.

payment/authorization-success.description: Emitted when payment authorization is successful but before the order is placed. This allows for validation or additional processing before order creation.

authorization.description: Payment authorization details including transaction ID, amount, and payment method used.

payment/authorization-failed.description: Emitted when payment authorization fails. This event provides error details to display to the customer and allows for retry logic.

error.description: Payment failure details including error code, message, and suggested next steps (e.g., 'try another payment method', 'contact your bank').
